m10.text: At Wizards of the Coast, a day's work includes Doug suggesting that a blue sleep spell should have duration, which Aaron Forsythe changes to reflect the flavor he hoped for.

Brady Dommermuth drops off a printout of a planeswalker sketch for a set a year away, and the team critiques it, while Jeremy Jarvis delivers web comic sketches featuring a younger version of a censored character.
Then the power goes out at the office, and developers play handwritten prototype decks by window light, with one asking whether a Wurm can be a Warrior.
